{{Quote|Last week, I saw my cousin crawling through the mud&mdash;a blaster burn through her gut, her legs crushed by one of the Jedi war machines&hellip; Was ''that'' pain, Jedi? And when she died in my arms what did ''I'' feel if not pain?|Alto Stratus, to General Norcuna|<ref name="Republic 56" />}}
A [[Jabiimi]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was a '''cousin''' of the [[Jabiimi Nationalists]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Alto Stratus]]. During the [[Battle of Jabiim]] between the [[Jabiimi Loyalists]] and the Jabiimi Nationalists, she had been shot in the [[Stomach/Legends|gut]] with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and then, her [[Limb/Legends|legs]] were crushed by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]]. Alto Stratus witnessed his cousin as she crawled through the mud. Severely injured, she [[Death/Legends|died]] in Stratus' arms, whose resolve to destroy the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] solidified. In the next week, Stratus remembered his cousin's death as he [[Dismemberment/Legends|beheaded]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Norcuna]] during the [[Battle of Choal|battle]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Choal]].<ref name="Republic 56" />
